text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp went by in a 
flash. Having spent a full summer, the 
young Mejiro Ryan was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It was a spleeeeeeendid summer with 
absolutely zero romance whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I smashed watermelons with vigor and 
helped carry the portable shrine behind 
the scenes at the summer festival, but 
that was it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It is NOT fine at all, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, it can't be helped. Whenever I 
think about the Arima Kinen, I just 
instinctively put training first...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think this is fine. Romance requires 
even more confidence than racing, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Someday, when my heart grows stronger, 
I'll be able to tell them myself that I 
love them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think that's the kind of love I want to 
strive for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to nitpick things like 
that!

The bus will depart shortly. Heading back 
to Tracen Academy, where our rivals await.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer, did you hear about this news?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri, is it true that this year's 
Arima Kinen will be your last run in the 
Twinkle Series...?

Even superstar Umamusume reach turning 
points. It seems that was the choice Oguri 
Cap made.

If that's the case, the next race will be 
my last chance to run...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I bet the Arima Kinen is going to be all 
about Oguri-san."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"She'll definitely come at me with 
extraordinary resolve... If I don't beat 
an Oguri-san like that, my dream will 
never..."

"At the very end, an outrageous ordeal 
presented itself. This winter, I must 
tackle it with everything I have."
